cd /Users/dct/.factory/missions/e194b9e3-6a67-42b9-bfc9-dd4e1ac23b0c/skills/integration-worker && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='SKILL.md'
s=open(p).read()
if not s.endswith('\n'): s+='\n'
s+='''
## M4 boundary flow (as built)

Source: scrutiny M4 round 1 reviews `validation/m4/scrutiny/reviews/m4-integrate-m3.json`, `m4-integrate-long-target.json`,
`m4-tooling-fixes.json`, `m4-contract-checks-gate.json` (and `m4-forge-off-without-flag.json` for the last item). It supersedes
the M3 flow of steps 2 to 3b where they differ.

- Order: `make integrate M=<m> FROM=<branch>` (merge, cached gate, boundary commit), then `git push origin mission/observatory-v1` and
  `git push origin wt/<m>`, then `make integrate-long M=<m>` as ONE background Script (`startInBackground`), then `make integrate`
  again when the message arrives (merge skipped, gate a HIT, the report reads `reports/integrate-long/<code_tree>.json`). Never set
  `INTEGRATE_LONG=1` on a first integration: the commit is not pushed yet, the `ci` job waits `CI_FIND_SECONDS` (120 s), exits 3 and the
  target ends RED (m4-integrate-long-target, `scripts/integrate.sh:142`). `FORCE=0` still forces (Makefile line 66, any non-empty
  `FORCE`); leave the variable unset.
- Staging files before the merge: run `python3 scripts/integrate-staging.py --check` on every staging file of the milestone (`--rev`
  for a branch; exit 2 prints every stray heading as file:line) before `git merge`. Repairing markers or headings after the merge
  changes the tree and costs a second full `make check` (m4-integrate-m3: 8ae8793 forced the second gate MISS, 85.676 s, tree a3adb9b3).
  `integrate.sh` step 1b runs the same check and stops before the first merge.
- SPEC rows and BACKLOG rows the integrator writes by hand carry the marker `integrator` (VAL-PROC-047 allows integrator-authored rows
  only when marked; m4-integrate-m3: F-132 to F-137 and B-087, B-088, B-091, B-103, B-113 were unmarked). A completed validator
  feature without a staging file is named in the boundary report with its feature id.
- `make usage`: never pass a `--to` earlier than the integrator's own gate runs (`USAGE_ARGS`); the default (generation time minus 1 s)
  covers them. A `--to` five minutes before generation, as VAL-TOOL-005 tells validators for their re-run, drops the integrator's gate
  from the Gates table (m4-tooling-fixes; M3 used `--to 18:19:14Z` and lost them). Note the re-issued waits definition (toolCallId, any
  action but kill) next to F-129 when merging its staging row.
- `scripts/contract-checks/git-baseline.txt`: move it to the boundary's merge or tip commit at EVERY boundary; otherwise g6
  `range_base` on the mission branch covers ever-older commits (m4-contract-checks-gate, handoff discoveredIssues[3]).
- Inbox: commit `docs/owner-feedback/inbox/` (`docs(owner-feedback): inbox files [skip ci]`) before the merge so the tree is clean.
- When merging staging files, name `FORGE_LIVE=1` (the owner's flag that lets the forge read the keychain; forge off without
  `GITHUB_TOKEN` or the flag, m4-forge-off-without-flag) in `.env.example` and in README "Environment and secrets".
'''
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
tail -5 SKILL.md | cut -c1-80
summary: Append M4 boundary flow to integration skill
